extraction.Name: Louise Larvine Wright
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the fellow who bought it told me I would lose it if I did not pay the tax; purchaser A. L. Crilly came to me and ask for $300 dollars back in order to pay the taxes on the land. I gave him the $300 and he gave back only $9.39 in the form of a check which I tried to cash but could not so I still have it. I did not want to give him back the money but he said if I did not pay the tax I would lose it any way.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband supports us but I do what I can.
extraction.NOTES: Sold land for $400 and was supposed to get 6 cows, one yearling heifer and calf, and two mares; received 5 cows and a calf and two mares, still short 1 cow and one yearling heifer. The day she signed the deed her husband at that time Charles Wright had a fainting spell and had not fully recovered, so Jack Martin signed the deed for him. Current husband is John Wright. There are nine people including husband John Wright depending on her for support. Patent was brought to her by Luther Wright. She tried to cash a check for $9.39 from A. L. Crilly but could not. Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929.
